text_block_list.text:
To think I couldn't even make the board... 
The road of the Twinkle Series really is 
steep, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I... need to get much, much stronger!

Looking firmly ahead precisely when faced 
with defeat— I was reminded once again of 
her strength.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! No matter how many times I 
lose, I won't get discouraged!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to keep running so I can 
become someone like Dad—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating that I lost, but... I'll 
use that frustration as a springboard to 
keep moving forward!
